thread:
sara: FYI received a ticket from Acme about trial balance not moving after dozens of API calls. They report balance still at 1000 after multiple text-gen and embedding requests. They included request id req_8f3b2 and SDK version 0.9.1.
eli: Can you paste the request id and a minimal repro (curl or SDK) they used? Also any response metadata they got?
sara: Here's the snippet they pasted (redacted keys). Note the custom header.
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-redacted" \ 
  -H "X-Prefer-Free-Quota: true" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"Summarize x"}'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "id": "res_01",
  "object": "generation",
  "billing": {"charged": false, "reason": "quota_route"}
}
```
sara: Customer says they saw normal responses and tokens in the payload seem non‑zero, but billing shows charged:false and their trial balance didn't change.
eli: Hmm. SDK shouldn't be adding X-Prefer-Free-Quota by default. @mike can you pull router/billing decision logs for req_8f3b2 and check what matched? Any recent FF changes?
mike: grabbing logs — paste below minimal extract (sanitized):
```
req_id=req_8f3b2 route=ingress-1 sdk_version=0.9.1 user_id=acct_acme trial_balance=1000 headers=["X-Prefer-Free-Quota: true"] decision={preferred_quota: "free_promo", user_eligible: false, final_route: "free_quota_override", billed=false}
```
mike: On the surface router honored the header override even though user_eligible=false. There was a safety flag added last week (ff_free_quota_strict=false) to help rollback a promo change; looks like its behavior inverted in one deployment. ops-bot might have the deploy record.
ops-bot: Deploy event: service=router commit=ab12c3 env=prod feature=ff_free_quota_strict toggled=false by deployer@ci at 2028-03-10T12:08:40Z. Auto rollback disabled.
eli: That explains it — header override + ff_false means the router still accepts header overrides. We need two actions: 1) short-term guard in billing to ignore header unless user_eligible=true, 2) patch the feature-flag evaluation to default to strict=true.
sara: For customer response: can we confirm workaround? If they remove the header from their SDK calls will they be charged normally?
mike: Yes. Quick test: repeated call without header returns billing.charged=true and trial_balance decremented. I repro'd locally using same req id pattern.
eli: Repro steps for eng:
1) Install SDK 0.9.1 and 0.9.2-rc (both observed).
2) Run generation request with X-Prefer-Free-Quota:true header set by SDK (or curl).
3) Observe router decision log shows final_route=free_quota_override and billing.charged=false.
4) Toggle feature flag ff_free_quota_strict to true in staging and repeat — header no longer promoted.

Workaround for support: tell customer to downgrade to SDK 0.9.0 OR patch their client to strip X-Prefer-Free-Quota header (temporary).
mike: I'll open billing ticket to add defensive check (ignore header if user_eligible=false) and schedule a hotfix. ETA ~4h for guard behind config and 48h for FF patch.
sara: I'll send customer the workaround and ETA. Adding follow-up todo in #eng-sre and will escalate if they push back. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
eli: Adding note to changelog and will watch metrics for similar requests. :eyes:
